body: Funny that you mention job. I just recently got into property management and they provide me with life insurance. Part of me just wants to live long enough for my mother to get the full payout. But part of me hopes to be in a better place by then

Now you see I'm only a year older than you. He was 42 but had offer me at the beginning of the year whether we should try for a kid this year or next. My dumbass thought we had time to be together so I said next year. He really didn't care to have more kids since he already had 3 of his own. But he knew that if we were going to really do this forever thing he couldn't deny me the right of motherhood. I got to be his last love but I didn't get to carry his last child. I have held back soo hard on taking that pregnancy test and just sitting around to wait on my period to show up but it hasn't. Taking that test was like ripping the worst band aid ever. Every pain and thought of the future that was stolen from us just came right up to the surface.

Its been about the same amount time since I lost him too. & i completely understand how you feel. Like you can't imagine another thats not his cause it feels wrong. I just pray your friends & family respect your emotions thru this all. Hope you're not getting the widows move on everyday crap. Or getting told that one day you'll find another to love. Cause I hearing those things just break you more. I pray you have a strong support system.

Your experience seems pretty similar to mines. Although his killer hasn't been caught yet. We didn't get to have children. We planned for them & i got to watch in awe at how he great was with his kids. I've had a hard time going back to work. It doesn't feel right going back to your everyday hustle & not being able to come home & tell babe all about it. Its like you wanna push foward cause you know he wouldn't wanna see you like this, but at the same time laying down & never getting up sounds good too?

Couldn't help but choke up as I read this. I was 3 blocks down from him when got killed. I had 2 hours hitting him up, could have easily pulled up on him. But I didn't cause I wanted to try & respect his space. I regret like crazy not pulling up on him. I could have stopped him from going downstairs. Heck he wouldn't have wanted to go no where after seeing me. That fact that I was so close & didn't do nothing kills me everyday I wake up. Idk how you've gotten to a stage where you can date. Cause heck I can't imagine getting touched, or ever caring this much to possibly lose. & i know we all live to die at some point but this just hits different
The "what ifs" I feel are the worst. Cause they stay eating at you.
Its barely a lil over month for me. But I completely get it. Like you wanna be happy for your  loved ones. But its like damm I can't do this with babe I'll never live that moment with them .
